findings.detail: The evidence receipt resolves eleven selected validated ingest units with exact hashes and no duplicate references.
All six substantive sections in the proposed note have one exact reviewed evidence binding.
EDPB material is used as GUIDANCE and the Microsoft transparency report as RESEARCH; no binding claim is emitted.
Current amendments, supervisory interpretations and sector-specific applicability were not assessed.
The local fidelity receipt is hash-bound and descriptive; the Microsoft page with REVIEW_REQUIRED is not used for diagram claims.
